scope.inference_frame: Propuesto: estudiantes adultos matriculados en ESPE sede Latacunga, una sede e invitación voluntaria; requiere ratificación institucional y ética

construct.name: desempeño atencional en tarea digital de cancelación visual
not_equivalent_to: d2-R estandarizado o sus baremos sin equivalencia documentada

convergent_self_report.exact_wording: Durante la fase que acaba de terminar, ¿tu atención estaba principalmente en la tarea?

hypotheses.statement: En fases sondeadas, en_tarea se asocia con mayor F1_tarea concurrente que fuera_de_tarea.
En fases observables, orientado_a_tarea se asocia positivamente con autoinforme en_tarea.
hypotheses.analysis: logistic mixed model: probe_on_task ~ observer_task_oriented + phase_index + (1|participant)

hypotheses.statement: La pendiente lineal de F1_tarea a través de las 14 fases difiere de cero.
hypotheses.analysis: mixed model: F1_tarea ~ phase_index + (1 + phase_index|participant); simplify random slope only if singular according to frozen rule

hypotheses.statement: El score visual discrimina orientación observable en un holdout por participante.
hypotheses.target: orientado_a_tarea vs orientado_fuera_de_tarea; exclude no_observable with denominator reported
hypotheses.interpretation_limit: classification of visible orientation, not internal attention
hypotheses.threshold_and_minimum_effect: TBD before G3 and before opening holdout

sampling.method: consecutive volunteer recruitment with prespecified quotas where feasible
inclusion: current university enrollment in approved frame
separate valid camera consent if camera subset
exclusion_before_outcomes: minor or age cannot be verified
duplicate or technical account identified before outcomes
no task outcome can be recorded
sampling.smallest_effect_of_interest: Provisional: adjusted mean difference of 0.10 F1_tarea units
sampling.ratification: Simulation with blinded pilot variability required before recruitment
sampling.stopping_rule: collect until frozen target_n or frozen maximum_n; never inspect effects to stop

missing_data.primary: available eligible phases in prespecified mixed model
sensitivity: participants with all five probes complete
plausible extreme-case bounds for missing probe outcomes

analysis_rules.subgroup_rule: descriptive coverage and uncertainty unless adequately powered and preregistered
analysis_rules.insufficient_sample_interpretation: insufficient evidence, never absence of bias

decisions_required_before_approval: D01 institutional and ethics ratification of ESPE Latacunga recruitment frame
D03 independent methodological ratification of SESOI and sample simulation
D05 designation of second blinded annotator and ethics acceptance of live observation
D08 independent approver and external timestamp for Zenodo preregistration

decisions_recorded_by_g0_form.D04: exact Spanish self-report and response options fixed
decisions_recorded_by_g0_form.D07: confirmatory and technical covariates closed; demographics exploratory and consented
